verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches fast iteration indirectly. Editor plugins can be built in GDScript 'without even reloading the editor', EditorScripts can be run instantly from the Script Editor (Ctrl+Shift+X) while the editor is running, and a community user says Godot 'starts up in seconds' compared to Unity. None of this documents hot reload of game scripts or near-instant preview after a script change. Missing for 10: documented script hot reload into a running game, live preview after edits, C# reload behavior, hands-on or measured edit-run loop timings.
